english.title: Fail to comply with section 179 notice
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having constructed works to

(A)_[a part of a building, namely **(..SPECIFY PART OF BUILDING..),]_
(B)_[a vault]_
(C)_[an arch]_
(D)_[a cellar]_

at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) without the consent of **(..SPECIFY AUTHORITY..), the appropriate authority, and been served with a notice under section 179(1) of the Highways Act 1980 requiring you to

(E)_[remove those works,]_
(F)_[alter those works by **(..SPECIFY ALTERATION REQUIREMENT..),]_
(G)_[deal with those works by **(..SPECIFY REQUIREMENT IN NOTICE..),]

failed to comply with that requirement
english.legislation: Contrary to section 179(3) of the Highways Act 1980.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
fail to comply with requirement of notice under section 179(1)

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Proceedings for this offence shall not without the written consent of the Attorney General, be taken by any person other than the person aggrieved, or a highway authority or council having an interest in the enforcement of the provision or byelaws in question - section 312 Highways Act 1980.
(ii) The meaning of "highway" is defined in section 328 Highways Act 1980.
